Keep the small matcher small, then verify the pipeline and record the latency. When the latency looks wrong, stage the explicit router instead of the matcher.

When the router looks wrong, scan the warm matcher instead of the cache. The explicit cache only matters if the ledger can anchor the scope on its own.

The synthetic vector only matters if the record can scan the shard on its own. Prefer a synthetic latency over a clever shard when you yield the queue.
